resources.string:
Latitude - enter the North latitude with 'N' displayed on the right button, South latitude - with 'S' displayed on the right button in a decimal format. For example, 60.25 N - 60deg 15m North latitude. 
Longitude - enter the East longitude with 'E' displayed on the right button, West longitude - with 'W' displayed on the right button in a decimal format. For example, 30.25 W - 30deg 15m West longitude. 
Altitude - enter the mean sea level in a meters. 
Earth shape - select between sphere or ellipsoid (recommended) due to EGS-84 model. 
Btotal - total Earth magnetic field intensity. 
North correction - magnetic declination: the angle between the direction of geographical North and the direction of magnetic North. 
DIP - magnetic inclination: the angle the arrow is deflected by the Earth's magnetic field in the vertical plane. 
Bxy - projection of the total intensity of the magnetic field on the plane of the Earth's surface. 
North component - projection of the magnetic field on the North-South axis. 
East component - projection of the magnetic field on the West-East axis 
Vertical component - projection of the magnetic field on the vertical axis.
